checks.output: Ending replay checks passed: first tour, return, letter Assign, task priority, repeated tours and reload.

limits: Full campaigns execute deterministic browser-side world-time driving, not hours of literal wall time. A separate rendered RAF check validates real-time integration.
Normal-path campaigns include live game branches but disable browser timers and rendering. Scripted delays and real rendering are checked separately.
Fixed-step exact equivalence is shown for the matched input/action/RNG sequence, not for human decisions or every rendered random trajectory.
Capacity fixtures use granted capital; paid campaigns and three 20-minute source detours do not.
The isolated UI prototype multiplies historical simulation timestamps for display. Preserving existing elapsed-time history across future tempo changes still needs accumulated real-time accounting.
Human comfort and motion smoothness are not established by automated checks. At a 60 Hz simulation step, the 1.2 candidate advances world state on 50 of 60 rendered frames.
